title: A fourth pin is refused with a message, unpinning frees a slot
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Three technicians already pinned; in Board View.
custom_steps:
1. With three pinned, try to pin a fourth technician.
  2. Read the disabled pin control's message.
  3. Unpin one technician.
  4. Confirm a slot is free in both Board View and Tech View.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When three technicians are pinned, the other pin controls are disabled and show "You can pin up to 3 technicians."
  • Unpinning a technician frees a pin slot in both Tech View and Board View.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10046 — Story 3 Board View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S3-R8, S3-R19 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
